svg.aria-label: Space Drums, a drum kit you play in thin air. A mirrored webcam view shows seven virtual zones: crash, ride, hi-hat, tom 1, tom 2, snare and floor tom. Two sticks with red painted tips swing onto the zones in an alternating left and right pattern; each tip is tracked, its predicted path is drawn before impact, and every hit flashes the zone. Side panels show each hand's commit state machine moving through idle, armed, committed and refractory, and the audio output waveform with the Salamander sample that played. A strike timeline at the bottom scrolls the pattern past a now line.
svg.title: Static (reduced motion): Space Drums live stage
